name: layout-inspector
description: the layout-inspector plugin, where the person installed it

tools.hint: measure the rendered page instead of judging it by eye: detect_issues (or compare_viewports for every breakpoint), element_context for the cause, then measure again after the fix; check_environment says why a browser will not start; check_design_system when the project names its design system (its token prefix and the brand overlay's values): values off its tokens and text contrast on the render. It measures a page that renders: the URL of a server this task started, else the repository's own build served or opened from a file:// path, or a small HTML fixture of the component

evidence.what: a measurement of the rendered page by layout-inspector (detect_issues, or compare_viewports for every breakpoint), taken after your last change
